common.tagline: Ask Your Data. Trust the Answer.
common.comingSoonDetail: This page is planned for implementation phase {{phase}} of the Wabi Insight roadmap.
common.apiOffline: The API is not reachable right now.

hero.title: From data chaos to confident decisions
hero.subtitle: Wabi Insight lets your teams ask natural-language questions about the enterprise data they are authorized to see, and returns verified answers, charts and reports they can trust and share.

ask.title: Ask in plain language
ask.text: Employees ask questions in English or Arabic and receive verified results, not guesses.

trust.title: Trust every answer
trust.text: Typed query plans, read-only execution and deterministic calculations keep numbers accurate.

secure.title: Secure by design
secure.text: Organization isolation, table, column and row permissions, encrypted connections, full audit.

share.title: Report and share
share.text: Dashboards, PDF, Word and Excel reports in both languages, shared under control.

step1.title: Connect
step1.text: Your administrator registers SQL Server or Oracle applications and approves the metadata users may see.

step2.title: Ask
step2.text: Users ask questions. The AI drafts a structured plan that Wabi Insight validates and authorizes before running read-only SQL.

step3.title: Decide
step3.text: Verified results become tables, charts, narratives and reports, saved to history and shared with the right people.

security.title: Built for multi-organization trust
security.text: Each organization keeps its own users, roles, data sources and history. The platform company operates the service without access to customer business data, and support work needs an approved, time-limited, audited grant.

points.isolation: Logical tenant isolation enforced in the database and the API
points.permissions: Table, column and row-level permissions applied before every query
points.audit: Append-only audit trail and support-access approval workflow
